pull.title: Prevent custody fault tests from writing bytecode
pull.body:
The custody OSError tests start a child Python interpreter without `-B`. When the outer suite runs with `-B` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` is unset, the child can leave `tools/__pycache__/periodic_pilot_custody.*.pyc` in the checkout. That conflicts with the clean-source guard exercised by Main #809.

Add `-B` to that child invocation and an isolated behavioral regression that runs the real fault path with the environment variable absent. The two existing OSError checks remain intact. Removing the added flag makes the new regression fail in both modes.

On the #809 tested tree, a separate instrumented hosted diagnostic observed `tools/__pycache__/periodic_pilot_custody.cpython-311.pyc` immediately before and after the same `SOURCE_MISMATCH` setup error. Its context differs from the original failing navigation run, which did not record the path; this is not a retroactive identification of the original file. The original diagnostic artifact, logs, exact source blobs, red controls and local reproductions are preserved at [evidence commit 8c3d8a55](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/8c3d8a55a947138e23c741f42654bb1c137c4080/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/observer-verified-summary.json).

Local focused checks: 3 tests per mode on CPython 3.12.14 and 3.13.5, no skips. The original invocation with the new regression failed once in each mode as expected. A separate hosted CPython 3.11.18 run `42798039955` passed the three focused tests in each mode; removing only the child `-B` made the new regression fail in each mode. Original artifact `13754053931` and its independently checked output are preserved at [evidence commit 59fdcaf8](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/59fdcaf887e83c488df37828adcf5a266bff725e/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/main812-focused-verified.json). The full navigation check remains pending; no full G5, CBZ-0 or scientific conclusion is claimed. This draft targets the active #809 branch and does not alter its ref.

**Adverse follow-up:** With a writable `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX` inherited by the child, removing `-B` caused bytecode to be written outside the regression's inspected directory and the regression incorrectly passed in both local parent modes. The original hosted observation remains valid for its captured environment, but this regression is not qualified for that adverse environment. A follow-up that clears the prefix in the isolated regression now passes the candidate and rejects the child-flag mutant in both local modes, including with the prefix set. The adverse logs and candidate are preserved at [evidence commit 4e048126](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/4e048126c619824a3c54d5a4d6ac375752d5a970/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/main812-prefix-adverse-summary.json). This follow-up is not yet on the PR: the current head is retained while its running checks finish.
